business_snapshot.text: For FY26, consolidated segmental revenues were: Financial Services ₹49,908 crore, Manufacturing ₹29,078 crore, Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services ₹23,818 crore, Retail ₹23,077 crore, Communication ₹21,765 crore, Hi-Tech ₹13,928 crore, Life Sciences ₹12,267 crore, and All other segments ₹4,809 crore.

financial_snapshot.text: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total revenue from operations was ₹1,78,650 crore.
On a consolidated basis for FY26, net profit was ₹29,440 crore.
For Q2 FY27, consolidated operating margin was stable at 21%.

trajectory.text: Consolidated revenues grew from ₹1,21,641 crore in FY22 to ₹1,78,650 crore in FY26.
Consolidated net profit increased from ₹22,110 crore in FY22 to ₹29,440 crore in FY26.
Consolidated basic earnings per share rose from ₹52.52 in FY22 to ₹71.58 in FY26.
